description:
Move a DID-LLM to new owners (a new key and/or wallet), signed by its owners. First
call, with did and the owners it will have afterwards: returns the change and its
messages. One current owner signs its "approve" message and each new owner its "accept"
message; send each with did, change_id, challenge_id and signature. The last one needed
applies the change (within 15 minutes): only the new owners control the DID-LLM and
sign-ins made before it end. With change_id alone: where it stands.

change_id.description: Leave empty to start a change; then the change_id it returned
change_id.title: Change Id

did.description: The DID-LLM (did:web:...:agents:...) or its identity ID (dmd_identity_...)
did.title: Did

new_controller_network.description: The wallet's network, eip155:8453 (Base) by default
new_controller_network.title: New Controller Network

new_controller_public_key.description: The owner key after the change, ed25519:z6Mk...: the current one to keep it, a new one to replace it, or empty to have none
new_controller_public_key.title: New Controller Public Key

new_controller_wallet_address.description: The owner wallet after the change, 0x..., the same way
new_controller_wallet_address.title: New Controller Wallet Address

name: debitmydata_change_owner
title: Change a DID-LLM's owners
